name: ChatPay Gateway for Bale
author: h031n

sections.description:
ChatPay Gateway for Bale pushes the boundaries of online payments in WooCommerce. This plugin allows you to connect your WooCommerce store directly to the Bale Messenger Digital Wallet. Without the need for intermediate gateways and with the highest possible speed, your customers can settle their invoices using their Bale wallet balance.

We developed this plugin focusing on high security, ultimate speed, and an unparalleled User Experience (UX). The seamless integration with WordPress REST API and modern Webhook architecture ensures that no order remains “Pending Payment” due to user browser closure or internet disconnection.

🚀 Key Features:

  • Frictionless Payment: Direct and smart redirection to the Bale app.
  • Instant Webhook Confirmation: Real-time Server-to-Server order status updates.
  • Smart Digital Delivery: Auto-sends purchased downloadable files directly to the customer’s Bale chat.
  • Visual Invoices: Automatically extracts product images and sends them to the Bale invoice.
  • Glass UI & Inline Keyboards: Sends order status messages with interactive inline buttons.
  • Manual Transaction Inquiry: Built-in tool to manually check pending transactions.
  • No “E-Namad” Required: Ideal for startups and social media businesses.

External services

This plugin relies on the official Bale Messenger API to function as a payment gateway and notification system.

  • What the service is and what it is used for: The plugin connects to the Bale API (https://tapi.bale.ai/bot and https://tapi.bale.ai/business/bot) to generate digital invoices, process payments via the Bale Wallet, register webhooks for real-time payment confirmation, and send digital receipts and downloadable products directly to the user’s chat.
  • What data is sent and when:
    • When a user initiates a payment, the plugin sends the Order ID, total amount, product image URLs, and store name to generate an invoice.
    • Upon successful payment, it may send digital files (if the product is downloadable) to the customer’s Chat ID.
    • During webhook registration, your site’s webhook URL is sent to the Bale API.
  • Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
    • Bale Official Website: https://bale.ai
    • Bale Developer Documentation: https://docs.bale.ai/
    • Bale Terms of Service: https://bale.ai/terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chatpay-gateway-for-bale directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enable “Bale Pay”.
  4. Click on “Manage” and enter your Bot Token and Provider Token received from @botfather in Bale.
  5. Go to the new gateway menu from the main admin menu and click “Register Webhook” to secure your connection.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support auto-delivery of digital products?

Yes! If you enable the “Auto Send Files” option in the settings, the plugin will automatically send the downloadable files (up to 20MB) directly to the customer’s Bale messenger chat upon successful payment.

What happens if the user closes the browser during payment?

Nothing is lost. Thanks to our dedicated Webhook architecture, the Bale server communicates directly with your WordPress server, securely updating the order status to “Completed” regardless of the user’s browser state.

Is my Bot Token secure?

Absolutely. All your sensitive information is securely stored in the WordPress database and is never exposed to the front-end. The Webhook endpoint is also protected using dynamic token validation to prevent spoofing attacks.

Does this plugin support currencies other than Toman?

Yes. The plugin smartly detects all common Iranian currencies configured in WooCommerce (IRR, Toman, HR, HT) and automatically performs the necessary conversions before sending the data to the Bale API.

What is Manual Transaction Inquiry?

If the webhook fails to trigger for any reason (e.g., your server experiencing downtime), you can navigate to the plugin’s admin dashboard, enter the Bale Transaction ID, and manually check the status directly from Bale’s servers.

1.0.0

  • 🚀 Initial stable release on WordPress.org repository.
  • ✨ Implementation of frictionless payment via Bale Digital Wallet.
  • 🔒 Highly secure Webhook system based on WP REST API with anti-spoofing logic.
  • 📦 Automated delivery system for downloadable products via Bale Chat.
  • 🖼️ Visual Invoices: Auto-extraction of product images for Bale payments.
  • 🛠️ Ultra Modern Admin Dashboard for Webhook registration and Manual Transaction Inquiry.
  • 📈 Full support for standard and Business Bale APIs.
